resources.string: Waiting for the car on your hotspot
Lets the car show your messages and reply to them.
Greyed out? Open App info, then ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, and try again.
Shows that the link with the car is running.
Keeps the link alive during long drives.
Turn it on and connect the head unit to it.
In Dashwheel, open Settings → Phone → Pair a phone, then scan the code it shows.
This car will show your notifications and messages, and can reply on your behalf. It only connects over your hotspot.
The car will no longer receive anything from this phone. Pairing again needs a new code.
That code downloads the app. Now scan the other one, the pairing code on the right of the head unit\'s screen.
This is not a Dashwheel pairing code (read: %1$s).
Shows who is calling on the car\'s screen, to answer or hang up from there. The sound stays on the car\'s Bluetooth.
